--- title: "Basemap gallery" bread-crumbs: false --- Every basemap in the catalogue that needs no API key, rendered for the same view of the San Francisco Bay Area (the Utah basemaps [below](#utah), over Salt Lake City). The names work as `style` anywhere: in `basemap()`, `add_basemap()`, `geom_basemap()` and in R and Rust. ::: {#64a26ce5 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import basemapper as bm providers = bm.list_providers() keyless = [p for p in providers if p["api_key_env"] is None] utah = [p for p in keyless if p["name"].startswith("UGRC.")] world = [p for p in keyless if p not in utah] print(len(world), "basemaps") images = {} for p in world: m = bm.basemap(p["name"], 340, 220, center=(-122.25, 37.75), zoom=9) images[p["name"]] = m.render_png() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` 23 basemaps ``` ::: ::: ::: {#f1695a6e .cell execution_count=2} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: The vector basemaps (OpenFreeMap, and Esri's vector styles) are drawn from vector tiles by basemapper's port of MapLibre GL JS; the raster ones are tile images. Esri's names have both forms; `basemap_provider(name, type="raster")` picks the other one. ## Utah {#utah} The Utah Geospatial Resource Center's vector basemaps cover Utah. Each is published as separate services (a hillshade, a base map and labels, or imagery and an overlay), and its name stands for the whole stack: `basemap_provider("UGRC.Lite")` returns the three styles, and `labels` and `features` treat them as one basemap. ::: {#81be2c6a .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} print([p["name"] for p in utah]) for p in utah: m = bm.basemap(p["name"], 340, 220, center=(-111.89, 40.70), zoom=10) images[p["name"]] = m.render_png() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` ['UGRC.Lite', 'UGRC.Dark', 'UGRC.Hybrid', 'UGRC.Outdoors'] ``` ::: ::: ::: {#8709d2f9 .cell execution_count=4} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## With an API key CARTO, Stadia Maps and MapTiler need a free API key, read from the environment variable in `api_key_env` (or given as `api_key=` to `basemap_provider()`): ::: {#ae6f614b .cell execution_count=5} ``` {.python .cell-code} for p in providers: if p["api_key_env"]: print(f"{p['name']:<26} {p['api_key_env']}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` CartoDB.Positron CARTO_API_KEY CartoDB.DarkMatter CARTO_API_KEY CartoDB.Voyager CARTO_API_KEY Stadia.AlidadeSmooth STADIA_API_KEY Stadia.AlidadeSmoothDark STADIA_API_KEY Stadia.AlidadeSatellite STADIA_API_KEY Stadia.OSMBright STADIA_API_KEY Stadia.Outdoors STADIA_API_KEY Stadia.StamenToner STADIA_API_KEY Stadia.StamenTonerLite STADIA_API_KEY Stadia.StamenTerrain STADIA_API_KEY Stadia.StamenWatercolor STADIA_API_KEY MapTiler.Streets MAPTILER_API_KEY MapTiler.Basic MAPTILER_API_KEY MapTiler.Bright MAPTILER_API_KEY MapTiler.Outdoor MAPTILER_API_KEY MapTiler.Topo MAPTILER_API_KEY MapTiler.Dataviz MAPTILER_API_KEY MapTiler.Satellite MAPTILER_API_KEY ``` ::: :::
